description: This file contains functions for printing and formatting X509_NAME structures, including indentation, separator handling, and output to BIO or FILE streams. It is part of the BoringSSL cryptographic library, specifically related to X.509 certificate name printing.

methods.name: maybe_write
methods.description: Writes buffer to BIO if BIO is not NULL, or returns length if BIO is NULL.

methods.name: do_indent
methods.description: Prints specified number of spaces to BIO.

methods.name: do_name_ex
methods.description: Formats and prints an X509_NAME structure with specified indentation and flags.

methods.name: X509_NAME_print_ex
methods.description: Prints an X509_NAME with extended formatting options.

methods.name: X509_NAME_print_ex_fp
methods.description: Prints an X509_NAME to a FILE stream with extended formatting options.
